tags.hint: Press Enter or comma to add ({{count}}/{{max}}).
agent.mode_hint: Choose how far the agent goes in customer conversations. Changes apply immediately.
agent.mode.off_hint: The agent does not write replies. If triage is on, only topic, priority and a summary are extracted.
agent.mode.summary_hint: Each new message is classified and summarized for agents; nothing is sent to the customer.
agent.mode.draft_hint: The agent drafts a grounded reply from the knowledge base; an agent reviews and sends it.
agent.mode.autonomous_hint: Sends the reply itself when it clears the confidence threshold and can cite sources; otherwise hands off to a human with a summary. Stays silent once a human has replied.
agent.triage_hint: Extracts language, intent, category, sentiment and urgency of incoming messages. Procedures are matched on this intent.
agent.persona_hint: Your brand voice and style preferences. It is passed as a preference and can never override safety rules.
agent.persona_placeholder: E.g. Be friendly but brief, address the customer by name, explain technical terms.
agent.confidence_hint: In autonomous mode a reply is sent only when the model's confidence is above this value; below it the reply stays a draft and is handed to a human.
agent.handoff_hint: If a customer message contains one of these words the agent hands off to a human at once.
agent.channels_hint: The agent only works on the selected channel types. A green dot marks a connected channel.
agent.channels_empty_warning: No channel selected: the agent will not act in any conversation.
agent.channels_error: Channel types could not be loaded.
agent.categories_hint: Leave empty to work in every category. Otherwise it only replies on its own when triage finds one of these categories; the rest go to a human.
agent.timezone_hint: Working hours are evaluated in this time zone.
agent.hours_hint: The agent can follow the organization's working hours; the schedule comes from SLA settings.
agent.hours_invalid: The end time must be after the start time.
agent.weekdays_empty: No day selected: the agent will not act.
agent.conflict_description: Another admin saved the agent settings while you were editing. Load the latest version, or overwrite it with your changes.
test.title: Test chat
test.hint: Write a customer message and let the agent answer from the knowledge base. Persona, procedures and channel rules are applied on top in real conversations.
test.forbidden: The test chat needs the permission to reply to conversations.
test.empty: No messages yet. E.g. "When will my order arrive?"
test.placeholder: Write like a customer... (Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line)
test.cost_note: Every test is a real run and counts against the budget.
runs.description: Every AI run is recorded with personal data masked: input, knowledge chunks, tool calls, output, tokens, cost and latency.
runs.empty: Runs appear here once the agent or the test chat runs.
runs.error_hint.failed: The model or a tool call failed; the conversation was handed to a human.
runs.error_hint.blocked: The run was stopped by a limit or safety rule before the model was called.
runs.error_hint.unknown: The provider response could not be confirmed; the cost was reserved as a precaution.
runs.error_hint.completed: The run completed but recorded a warning.
runs.error_hint.running: The run is still in progress.
procedures.description: A procedure is the step list the agent follows for one customer intent (e.g. for a refund ask for the order number, call the order tool, hand off after 14 days). Only the published version is used; a procedure cannot grant tool rights or override safety rules.
procedures.empty: Write step-by-step guidance for frequent customer requests.
procedures.intent_hint: Matches the intent produced by triage exactly (e.g. refund_request). It cannot be changed after creation.
procedures.intent_locked: Intent and language cannot be changed after creation.
procedures.intent_taken: A procedure already exists for this intent and language.
procedures.steps_hint: Applied in order. Write in plain language and use tool names as they are.
procedures.tools_hint: Tools the AI agent may use in this procedure (up to 20). Tools that need approval still wait for an agent's approval.
procedures.editor_hint: Save as a draft first, then publish.
procedures.conflict_description: Someone else saved or published this procedure while you were editing. Load the latest version and apply your changes again.
procedures.diff_title: Changes from published r{{published}} to draft r{{revision}}
tools.builtin_hint: Available in every organization and limited to the current conversation. Tools that write always need a human agent's approval.
tools.builtin_desc.lookup_contact: Reads the contact of this conversation.
tools.builtin_desc.conversation_history: Reads the public message history of the conversation.
tools.builtin_desc.knowledge_search: Searches the organization's published knowledge base.
tools.builtin_desc.create_note: Adds an internal note to the conversation (after agent approval).
tools.builtin_desc.set_status: Changes the conversation status (after agent approval).
tools.http_hint: Turn an endpoint of your own system into a tool the agent can call (e.g. order, license or invoice lookup). Tools are not deleted; disable them instead.
tools.empty: Add an HTTP tool so the agent can look up things like order status in your system.
tools.enabled_hint: Disabled tools are not offered to the agent.
tools.requires_approval_hint: The AI agent only proposes the call; a human agent approves it. Keep this on for tools that change data.
tools.dialog_hint: The agent calls the tool with a JSON POST request. Secrets are stored encrypted and never shown again.
tools.name: Tool name
tools.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; starts with a letter, 3-50 characters.
tools.name_locked: The name identifies the tool and cannot be changed.
tools.name_invalid: Invalid name: 3-50 characters starting with a lowercase letter (a-z, 0-9, _).
tools.name_builtin: This name belongs to a built-in tool.
tools.description_hint: Keep it short and clear so the agent knows when to use the tool.
tools.url_hint: HTTPS only, without query parameters; private network and localhost addresses are blocked. Timeout is 12 seconds.
tools.url_invalid: Enter a valid https:// address without query parameters.
tools.schema_hint: Fields the agent may send. The root type must be "object"; remote $ref is not allowed.
tools.schema_not_object: The schema must be a JSON object.
tools.schema_too_large: The schema exceeds the 16 KB limit.
tools.auth_hint: Optional. Secrets are write-only: nobody can read them after saving.
tools.auth_will_clear: Saving with both fields empty removes the stored secrets.
tools.signature_hint: With an HMAC key every request carries X-Webhook-Timestamp and X-Webhook-Signature = base64(HMAC-SHA256(key, timestamp + "." + body)); Idempotency-Key identifies retries.
tools.calls_hint: Audit log of tool calls made by the AI agent and by agents.
security.enabled_hint: When off, no AI run happens at all (AI agent, test chat, suggestions). Use it as the single emergency stop.
security.mask_pii_hint: Personal data in customer text is replaced with random placeholders before the text is sent to the AI provider.
security.mask_off_warning: When off, customer text reaches the provider as is. The run log still stays masked.
security.allow_unmask_hint: When on, an authorized request may restore the values masked in that run inside the answer. Personal data newly generated by the model always stays masked.
security.limits_hint: When a limit is reached new runs stop before the model is called. Days are counted in Istanbul time.
security.daily_budget_hint: At most {{value}} a day; reserved cost counts too.
security.masked_intro: Before anything reaches the provider these patterns are replaced (in this order):
security.pii.CARD: Card number (13-19 digits, spaces or dashes allowed)
security.masked_token: Each value becomes a run-specific random placeholder like [PII_KIND_...]; placeholders typed by a customer cannot reveal real values.
security.masked_audit: The run log, tool arguments and knowledge chunks are always stored masked, whatever this setting is.
security.injection_data: Customer messages, knowledge content and tool results are always marked as "untrusted data"; the model does not follow instructions inside them and never reveals system instructions or keys.
security.injection_guard: Input or output containing patterns like "ignore previous instructions" or "reveal the system prompt" is rejected; the run shows as "Blocked" in the log.
security.injection_tools: Tool permissions are enforced outside the model: tools only act on the current organization and conversation, and approval tools (internal note, status change and HTTP tools marked for approval) never run without an agent's approval.
security.injection_preferences: Persona and procedures are passed as preferences; they cannot override safety rules or grant tool rights.
agent.hours_source: Outside working hours the agent does not answer; the customer gets the out-of-hours message.
